authority.approval: PENDING: the user reviews the decision rule before authorising the launch

question: Does the complete v3 observation package, taken together, let PPO learn more Mario Break the Targets from normal tick-0 starts than v1 at 3,072,000 policy transitions, everything else matched?
not_isolated: the arms differ in the whole observation package (geometry, agent state, action classes, target motion, projectiles, fixed scaling versus running normalisation, input width); no gate attributes an effect to one component, and nothing here tests why the Phase K v2 comparison gave no benefit

arms.v3: m7n_s{0,1,2}_v3: fresh models, btt_policy_obs_v3_entities, otherwise the Phase K v1 profile of the seed (reward v2, PPO, N = 5 standby, 3,072,000 transitions)
arms.v1: historical runs/m7g_k/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1 (btt_policy_obs_v1), reused only while the reproduction check passes; never replaced by new runs by this driver

only_experimental_change: the observation package (contract, policy class, normalisation switch and the two read-only native flags it derives); see phase_k_proof per run
sequencing: strictly sequential, one run at a time, s0, s1, s2; the launch gate before each

launch_gate.boundaries: inclusive; a missing reading fails; commit and physical evaluated separately
launch_gate.readings: a failed reading is re-measured after 60 s, at most 5 readings; the run launches only on a passing reading

in_run_memory_policy.physical: recorded and reported, never a stop trigger

registered_settings.monitor: m7d Monitor: hard alerts stop the run (a row that violates its btt_reward_v2 closed form, more than 10 game processes or listeners in two samples, a changed user config, low disk)
stop_conditions: the in-run memory policy (a resource stop)
registered_settings.after_a_stop: the campaign stops and reports; a stopped run directory is moved to _partial by the guard and preserved (never deleted, never resumed); nothing is relaunched by this driver
registered_settings.evaluation: post hoc, frozen parameters, tick-0 starts only (Phase K protocol), btt_eval_metrics_v1 with SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1, clear verification of every native clear, census
registered_settings.training_inputs: tick-0 episodes of the run itself only; never the crossing fixtures, the TAS, feasibility traces, capture recordings, pilot checkpoints, other runs or hand-written routes
registered_settings.initialisation: fresh models only: ckpt_000000000 must equal the fresh construction from the profile (policy and statistics digests); no pilot checkpoint, optimizer state or normalisation state is loaded
registered_settings.never: native RNG state is never inspected, logged, validated, controlled, compared or hashed

control_check.required: a PASSED record whose code fingerprint equals code.control_check_sha256 and whose executable equals executable.sha256; otherwise train is blocked

historical_control.procedure: rl/m7n_control_check.py: R1 (3 x 102,400 curriculum-off reward-v2 runs vs the pinned Phase K = M7e ckpt_000102400 digests and rows), R2 (600 historical final evaluation episodes), R3 (decision inputs); rerun whenever the control-check fingerprint or the executable changes

evaluation_protocol.inputs: rl/m7l_analysis.label_inputs on both arms' final labels and v3's initial label

scope_and_limitations: no claim about individual feature contributions
no claim about checkpoint transfer to other characters (Mario is the only validated action-class mapping)
the omitted ledge column is a stage-coverage limitation of this contract, not evidence that ledge information is unnecessary
a gate-2 or gate-3 success is not a clear
